name: @sos-2/adapters
description: SOS 2.0 Platform Adapters: replaceable adapter CONTRACTS (interfaces + in-memory reference implementations) for the reference stack — RepositoryAdapter (durable store for spine envelopes/trace links), TelemetryIngestionAdapter (OTel-shaped backends -> raw observations), ReasoningProviderAdapter (LLM providers behind a reasoning-provider contract, outputs marked NON-AUTHORITATIVE per spec/architecture.md section 18) and ExecutionAdapter (running candidate code, authority-gated through @sos-2/authority grant evaluation). Adapters CANNOT redefine semantics: every adapter output is a structural bridge onto a domain type from the workspace packages, enforced by a type-level constraint plus a runtime guard that REJECTS novel semantic concepts (Work Order W12; spec/architecture.md section 17 platform neutrality, docs/implementation/REFERENCE-STACK.md, R18).
